RF-Scope APK build information
==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.2.0 (versionCode 2)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-07 (Asia/Shanghai)
APK SHA-256: 1697c2f7f849a33bd0556a15c96bc4d3f760bdd65a04aa562e89b0959439a775
Size: 24546879 bytes

Changes in 0.2.0:
- Automatic first-launch permission request.
- Separate cellular and Wi-Fi permission actions with Settings fallback.
- Android 13+ Wi-Fi scan now uses NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES with neverForLocation.
- Visible refresh spinner / SYNC state.
- Highlighted n41, FREQ, PCI, RSRP, RSRQ, SINR tiles.
- Three parallel signal trend charts (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR).
- Corrected hardware hierarchy: PHONE -> TINYSA ULTRA -> HT8 ANTENNA.
- Added NCI, SSB bands, CSI metrics and signal level where Android exposes them.

Notes:
- Requires a real Android phone with SIM for meaningful cellular telemetry.
- NSA/SA NR band/frequency visibility depends on modem and OEM ROM.
- TinySA USB serial transport is reserved; it is not yet implemented.
